metadata.description: Sandbox marketplace for the AI SDLC framework: orchestration engine, plus the spec/eval, tech-design, implementation, documentation, and testing agents.

plugins.name: orchestration-engine
plugins.description: Deterministic Complexity Vector (S, D, H) analysis, the 3-level execution matrix (pipeline strategy, model tier, token cap), and the lifecycle state machine that enforces draft / ask-clarification / decline decisions and sequential gating across the SDLC pipeline agents.

plugins.name: sdlc-agents
plugins.description: The six AI SDLC pipeline agents (spec-eval, tech-design, tech-design-eval, implementation, documentation, testing) for ServiceNow scripted REST, Kafka and .NET work, each reporting a draft / ask_clarification / decline decision for the orchestration engine to enforce.
